differences.a_observable: Crevices between the tiles have deep, dark shadows, providing strong contrast and depth.
differences.b_observable: Crevices between the tiles are brightly lit with very shallow shadows, making the layout look flat.
differences.fix: Adjust the ambient occlusion or shadow settings to deepen the crevices between tiles.

differences.a_observable: The yellow Recurly card has a satin-like material finish with soft specular highlights reflecting the light source.
differences.b_observable: The yellow Recurly card has a flat matte finish with almost no specular reflection, appearing uniform in color.
differences.fix: Increase the specular intensity or adjust the roughness of the yellow card material to match the satin sheen of the reference.

differences.a_observable: The camera has a wider field of view, showing more surrounding tiles and a greater sense of perspective.
differences.b_observable: The camera has a narrower field of view, making the central cards appear larger and showing fewer surrounding tiles.
differences.fix: Increase the camera's field of view (FOV) or move the camera further back to match the reference framing.

json.highest_impact_fix: Adjust the lighting and ambient occlusion to deepen the shadows in the tile crevices, which will significantly improve the depth and contrast of the scene.
